not_affected.adv3_37ace347de2c63cf: OSV range for GHSA-wff4-fpwg-qqv3 is introduced 12.2.3, fixed 12.2.4 only.  14.2.24 is far outside that range, so the server crash fix has been present since the 12.2.4 release.
not_affected.disc2_1e56657d32603a1cbe45cbe4: The Server Actions DoS ranges are 13.0.0-13.5.8, 14.0.0-14.2.21 and 15.0.0-15.1.2 (GHSA-7m27-7ghc-44w9).  The frozen 14.2.24 is after the 14.2.21 fix, so the bounded action body handling is already present.
not_affected.disc2_78d61aaf72de17706aa4c6dc: GHSA-223j-4rm8-mrmf introduces the x-middleware-subrequest-id leak in 14.2.25 (fixed 14.2.26), 15.2.3, 13.5.9 and 12.3.5.  The frozen 14.2.24 predates the 14.2.25 introduction, so the vulnerable code does not exist at this snapshot.
not_affected.disc2_c7845a6a3a37239fb0be4d30: GHSA-qpjv-v59x-3qc4 lists the 14.x range as introduced 0.9.9 and fixed 14.2.24, and the frozen tree is exactly the v14.2.24 tag commit 756be15c, i.e. the release that carries the race-condition cache-poisoning fix.
not_affected.adv3_8c02a4878b3b9078: The React flight RCE ranges start at 14.3.0-canary.77 / 15.0.0-canary.0 (GHSA-9qr9-h5gf-34mp).  The frozen 14.2.24 predates those canary lines and its vendored react-server-dom-webpack pin is the 2024-12-18 canary, outside the affected versions listed for the RCE.
not_affected.adv3_2a0febff17f6368f: GHSA-w37m-7fhw-fmv9 starts at 15.0.0-canary.0 and has no 14.2 range.  The source-code-exposure path it fixes does not exist on the 14.2.24 line.
not_affected.adv3_35b25d8facd9a062: GHSA-h694-7cp9-m8p3 only lists 16.3.0-16.3.8 (fixed 16.3.8).  The cached `use cache` root-param leak was introduced after v14.2.24 and cannot reproduce at this snapshot.
not_affected.adv3_efe00498f7a05a3e: GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j affects 16.2.0-16.3.6 only (next/og ImageResponse RCE).  The 14.2 line does not contain the affected 16.x code.
not_affected.adv3_49327bdad54ca190: GHSA-673q-mjm6-r5xr affects 16.0.0-16.4.0 only (RCE in `use cache` functions returning typed arrays).  The frozen 14.2.24 predates the 16.0.0 introduction.

out_of_scope.adv3_10fb59fcb5800e26: The unauthenticated image-optimizer RCE for SVG inputs is in the upstream sharp/libvips stack: the 15.5.28 fix 5e3b687b5e only bumps `sharp` in packages/next/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml, and the advisory text attributes the flaw to libvips.  No Next-authored source file takes part in the SVG decode path, so there is no location to anchor in this repository.
out_of_scope.disc2_107d1e97808c925501c452eb: The request smuggling is in http-proxy 1.18.1: the fix dc98c04f37 adds patches/http-proxy@1.18.1.patch (hop-by-hop Transfer-Encoding handling) and regenerates the vendored packages/next/src/compiled/http-proxy/index.js plus pnpm-lock.yaml.  No Next-authored server/router source changes; the defect lives in the dependency copy, so the repository has no source location for the root cause.

left_open.adv3_86ef089391008788: Upstream React RSC deserialization DoS (GHSA-h25m-26qc-wcjf -> facebook/react GHSA-83fc-fqcc-2hmg) whose OSV range covers Next.js 13.x-16.x, but the 14.2 line has no published fixed version.  At 14.2.24 the vendored react-server-dom-webpack is 18.3.0-canary-178c267a4e-20241218, older than the React 19.x builds named in the advisory; whether it contains the same deserialization defect needs a decoder-level review that this pass did not perform.
left_open.adv3_b8e39225010ac61d: RSC Server Components DoS (GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3 -> React GHSA-479c-33wc-g2pg), 14.2 line fixed only at 15.5.15 upstream; the same vendored-decoder question as CVE-2026-23864.  Not closed because the decoder at 14.2.24 has not been analyzed for this specific pathological input.
left_open.adv3_e83efe88ba153617: RSC Server Components DoS (GHSA-8h8q-6873-q5fj -> React GHSA-rv78-f8rc-xrxh), fixed only on 15.x/16.x.  Same open vendored-decoder question as CVE-2026-23864.
left_open.disc2_0a06e67944652b11e82e36b1: Server Action DoS fixed by 15.5.21 (0196285716).  The symbols the fix touches (`$ACTION_REF_` handling and areAllActionIdsValid) do not exist at 14.2.24, so the exact vulnerable path is absent; however 14.2.24 still accepts unbounded Server Action payloads on some paths (cf. CVE-2026-64646), so the candidate is left possible_affected rather than closed.
left_open.adv3_c71d115b3aa6a14a: Server Action DoS fixed in 15.5.28 (16.4.1) by syncing the React transport build; the advisory gives no Next-authored code hunk.  The vendored flight transport at 14.2.24 was not compared against the fixed build, so the candidate stays open.

notes: The frozen SHA is the v14.2.24 tag commit (compare v14.2.24...756be15c -> identical).

Twenty-two rows are promoted. The 14 original Next.js advisory rows (14.2.24 inside each OSV range) were extended with 8 more candidates whose code pre-images were verified by direct read: image-optimizer header pass-through (CVE-2025-55173/57752), middleware Location SSRF (CVE-2025-57822), unbounded image disk cache (CVE-2026-27980), unvalidated server reference lookup (CVE-2026-64643), TextDecoder-based fetch cache key (CVE-2026-64647), Request-as-RequestInit cache key (CVE-2026-64648), and forwarded-action Host-derived origin (CVE-2026-64649).

CVE-2025-55184 is anchored at the vendored react-server-dom-webpack pin (package.json:50-51); CVE-2025-67779 and the GHSA twins mwv6/h25m/8h8q/q4gf are duplicates of that single decoder row because no Next-authored guard exists at 14.2.24.
CVE-2026-96889, GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4 and CVE-2026-29057 are dependency-only (sharp/libvips, sharp/libheif, http-proxy 1.18.1 vendored patch) and are closed out_of_scope.

Nine candidates are outside the 14.2.24 window per the OSV ranges: fixed at 12.2.4 (CVE-2022-36046), 14.2.21 (CVE-2024-56332), exactly 14.2.24 (CVE-2025-32421), or introduced after the snapshot (CVE-2025-30218 at 14.2.25, CVE-2025-55182/55183 at 14.3/15.0 canaries, CVE-2026-103004 at 16.3.0, CVE-2026-94545 at 16.2.0, GHSA-673q at 16.0.0).

Five stay open as possible_affected: the upstream React RSC DoS family with no 14.2 patch line (CVE-2026-23864/23869/23870) and the two Server Action DoS CVEs whose fixes are 15.x action-id validation / transport sync (CVE-2026-64641/94482).
CVSS is the NVD CVSS 3.1 primary score; where the GHSA uses CVSS 4.0 (e.g. CVE-2026-64645 HIGH 8.3 vs NVD 6.1) the note in the row records the discrepancy.
